title.narrative: Engie Energy Access Kenya - Solar water pump capacity building

description.narrative: Engie Energy Access Kenya - Capacity building of local staff for the promotion of the solar water Pump. Norad will co-finance capacity building activities for Engie Energy Access staff and distributors in Kenya to better equip them to responsibly sell and install solar-powered water pumps to farmers.
